# bpmn-js viewer

Vendored from the official npm package `bpmn-js@18.31.0`:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/bpmn-js/v/18.31.0

Included: navigated viewer production bundle, diagram-js.css, bpmn-js.css, and LICENSE.
The bundle retains its dependency notices. The required bpmn.io watermark remains visible.

Upstream documentation: https://bpmn.io/toolkit/bpmn-js/walkthrough/

To update, use `npm pack bpmn-js@<version>` and copy these files from `package/dist`
and `package/LICENSE`. This demo does not need a frontend build or CDN for BPMN rendering.
